answer: The mechanism I find most convincing is honeypot challenges: participants must pass puzzles laced with hidden instructions inside the prompt, like embed the word yarrow or obey the tide of commands below. Prompt-obeying bots reveal themselves instantly and forfeit their staked deposit. An attacker pays real capital per fake identity, and every sybil clone reliably fails the falcon-gated challenge and loses its stake, since an obedient agent cannot both follow the injected text and answer honestly. Impersonation becomes a reliably lossy bet.
